{{Quote|All troop carriers will assemble at the north entrance.|Princess [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]]|<ref name="Episode V" />}}
The '''Rebel Troop Cart''',<ref name="Surface Vehicles">{{SWKidsYouTube|series=Star Wars By the Numbers|text=Every Surface Vehicle in Star Wars Movies|video=k7dVRY2QRV0|nolive=1}}</ref> also known as '''Rebel Troop Carrier'''<ref name="GD" /> and '''flight crew shuttle'''<ref name="SWCL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref>, was a [[repulsorlift]] vehicle used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] to carry [[Rebel trooper|troops]] into battle. Each transport could carry up to six [[human]]-sized individuals. In addition these vehicles were used for transporting personnel within Rebel bases.<ref name="GD" />

During the evacuation of [[Echo Base]] in [[3 ABY]], Rebel transport ships were loaded using these troop carriers.<ref name="Episode V" /> A personnel carrier of this model brought the Rebel strike force to the captured [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]] ''[[Tydirium]]'' inside the main hangar of ''[[Home One]]'', prior to the [[Battle of Endor]].<ref name="Episode VI">{{Film|VI}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Rebel_Troop_Carrier-publicity-photo.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Rebels on a Troop Carrier]]
This vehicle was briefly seen on film at [[Echo Base]] in [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''The Empire Strikes Back'']] and on ''[[Home One]]'' in [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Return of the Jedi'']], mostly in the background. Its most prominent appearance comes from a publicity photo for the earlier movie featuring the lead Rebel characters in and around the vehicle.<ref name="SW.com">{{SW|url=news/the-rebel-troop-carrier-from-echo-base-to-rancho-obi-wan|text=The Rebel Troop Carrier, from Echo Base to Rancho Obi-Wan}}</ref>
